name: Intertrigo
source:
You’re a doctor committed to helping the animals on the farm. Even if some of your approaches are slightly unconventional, your work is consistently effective.

[From [url=https://elllleonor.itch.io/intertrigo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名致力于帮助农场动物的医生。即使你的一些方法有点不传统，你的工作仍然有效。

[来自[url=https://elllleonor.itch.io/intertrigo]Itch.io[/url]]
